critical_code_review_comments: TvBroadcast.jsx singleton pattern is correctly implemented: module-level TV object with ensureNode() lazy-creates two <video data-role=live|intro> elements; useEffect appends them to hostRef on mount and relocates to getPark() (#tv-park appended to document.body) on cleanup. SPA navigation preserves playback (ct 72→78→81→84 verified) — exactly matches spec.
RadioContext.jsx shuffleRef/repeatRef pattern is correct — using refs avoids stale closure in onEnded handler. Repeat1 icon swap on pb-repeat verified in DOM.

ChannelHeader.jsx — TABS 'wide' flag + hidden xl:inline-flex correctly hides proiecte/despre below 1280px. At 1366 both are visible and do not overlap the centered logo (gap≥4px). MTABS correctly inserts mtab-proiecte with Library icon.

Noutati.jsx hero-play reads from the latest track and plays via RadioContext; home-popular is sorted by plays count (verified structurally). home-collections derived from distinct track.playlist values (3 non-empty groups observed in current seed).

Despre.jsx and Proiecte.jsx are real editorial pages — no lorem-ipsum, no invented facts. Despre body contains the required anchors (Cristian Maxim / Focșani / Sună și mergem / 19). Proiecte groups tracks by playlist field and surfaces loose singles + video grid correctly.

LOW NOTE (not blocking): page.goto() in tests causes full-page reload and defeats singleton continuity (resets #tv-park). Must use SPA Link clicks (data-testid='tab-*' / header-logo) to validate TV continuity. Reported here so future testing agents don't false-flag it as a bug — behavior is per design.

LOW NOTE: /tv chat requires guest to submit chat-name-input first before message input appears — this is correct existing UX; a quick test that only looks for chat-input will miss it until the name step is completed.
